en:
○ Undergraduate students who registered for a major course offered by another department (school)
○ Course classification (in the course registration record): 일반선택 (general elective)
※ Only possible if the course is not part of the student's main major or multiple major (including a multiple major the student plans to enter)
※ Cases where the grading method cannot be chosen:
- The course must be recognized as a major course (major elective/major required)
- The course belongs to the student's main major or multiple major
- The course must be completed as a major course (major elective/major required) under the graduation requirements
- The student plans to enter a multiple major in the future, and the course counts as a major course under that multiple major's requirements

All undergraduate major courses
※ However, this may not apply to some courses, depending on the course's nature and how it is run

1 Sep 2026 (Tue) 09:00 – 23 Sep 2026 (Wed) 23:59 (from the first day of the semester until 1/4 of the class days have passed)
Applications can be made or changed freely within this period (no additional applications after the period ends)
How to apply and choose the grading method

○ Menu: (student screen) mySNU → 학사정보 (Academic Information) → 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) → 수업 (Classes) → 성적평가방법변경신청 (Request to Change Grading Method)
○ Student request: letter grades (A~F) → pass/fail (S/U)
※ For some major courses, students can choose pass/fail (S/U) → letter grades (A~F)

Up to 9 credits in total during enrollment
※ If a student changes the grading method (A~F → S/U) and receives an S grade in a course, that course's classification cannot be changed (general elective → major elective/major required)

Grades are given using the grading method the student chose
※ If the student does not choose, the grading method set for the course applies
ko:

○ (수강신청내역 상 교과목) 교과구분: 일반선택
※ 해당 교과목이 학생의 주전공/다전공(진입 예정 포함)이 아닌 경우만 가능
※ 성적평가방법 선택 불가한 경우
- 해당 교과목을 전공(전선/전필)으로 인정받아야 하는 경우
- 학생의 주전공 및 다전공 교과목인 경우
- 이수요건 상 반드시 전공(전선/전필)로 이수해야 하는 경우
- 향후 다전공 진입 계획이 있으며 해당 교과목이 다전공 이수요건 상 전공에 해당되는 경우

전체 학부 전공 교과목
※ 다만, 교과목 특성 및 운영방식에 따라 적용되지 않을 수 있음

2026. 9. 1.(화) 09:00~9. 23.(수) 23:59 (개강일~수업일 수 1/4선)
기간 내 자유롭게 신청/변경 가능(기간 후 추가 신청 불가)

○ 메뉴: (학생 화면) mySNU → 학사정보 → 수업/성적 → 수업 → 성적평가방법변경신청
○ 학생 신청: 등급제(A~F) → 급락제(S/U)
※ 일부 전공 교과목은 급락제(S/U) → 등급제(A~F)로 선택 가능

재학 중 최대 9학점
※ 성적평가방법 선택(A~F → S/U)하여 S 성적을 받은 교과목은 교과구분 변경(일선 → 전선/전필) 불가

학생이 선택한 성적평가방법으로 성적 부여
※ 학생이 선택하지 않은 경우, 교과목에 설정된 성적평가방법 적용

blocks.en: Guide to the Grading Option Selection System for Major Courses of Other Departments, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
blocks.ko: 2026학년도 2학기 타 학과(부) 전공 교과목 성적평가방법 선택제 안내

blocks.en: 1. Background
blocks.ko: 1. 도입 배경

blocks.en: A. To give students more choice in taking major courses of other departments, and to reduce the burden of registering for, and earning grades in, other majors' courses caused by differences in students' background knowledge
blocks.ko: 가. 타 학과(부) 전공 교과목 선택권 확대 및 학생별 이해도 차이로 인한 타 전공 수강신청 및 성적 취득의 부담감 해소

blocks.en: B. To give students the opportunity to grow into interdisciplinary talents who explore diverse fields of study
blocks.ko: 나. 다양한 분야의 학문을 탐구하는 융합형 인재로 성장할 수 있는 기회 제공

blocks.en: 2. Grading Option Selection System for Major Courses of Other Departments | Category | Details | Introduced: 1st semester of the 2018 academic year | (Default setting) All undergraduate major courses (change of grading method set to 'Yes') | Instructors/ Applicable (Not applied) | If the selection system cannot be applied for unavoidable reasons such as the characteristics of the course or the way the class is run, Staff | Courses | it may be not applied by changing 'change of grading method' to 'No' and stating the related reason when requesting the course opening each semester.
blocks.ko: 2. 타 학과(부) 전공 교과목 성적평가방법 선택제 구분 내용 도입시기 2018학년도 1학기 (기본 설정) 전체 학부 전공 교과목 (성적평가 방법 변경 ‘예’) 교수자/ 적용 (미적용) 교과목 특성 혹은 수업 운영 방식 등 부득이한 사유로 선택제를 직원 교과목 적용할 수 없는 경우, 매 학기 교과목 개설 요청 시 성적평가 방법 변경 ‘아니오’ 변경 및 관련 이유 기재하여 적용하지 않을 수 있음

blocks.en: Undergraduate students who take major courses of other departments
blocks.ko: 학사과정 학생 중 타 학과(부) 전공 교과목을 수강하는 학생

blocks.en: ○ Students who are completing a first major or a multiple major (minor, double major, combined major, interdisciplinary major, student-designed major, convergence major, etc.) cannot select the grading option for courses of that department. | Eligible students
blocks.ko: ○ 주전공 및 다전공(부전공, 복수전공, 연합전공, 연계전공, 학생설계전공, 융합전공 등)이수 중인 경우, 해당 학과(부)의 교과목 성적평가방법 대상자 선택 불가

blocks.en: ○ Students who plan to enter a multiple major (minor, double major, combined major, interdisciplinary major, student-designed major, convergence major, etc.), or who must complete a course as 전선 (major elective) or 전필 (major required) under the completion requirements, should not select the grading option for courses of that department.
blocks.ko: ○ 다전공(부전공, 복수전공, 연합전공, 연계전공, 학생설계전공, 융합전공 등) 진입 계획이 있는 경우, 이수요건 상 반드시 전선/전필로 이수해야 하는 경우, 해당 학과(부)의 교과목 성적평가방법은 선택하지 않아야 함

blocks.en: Application period: 1 Sep 2026 (Tue) – 23 Sep 2026 (Wed) (from the first day of classes until 1/4 of the class days)

Students apply within the period (approval of the instructor in charge is not required) | Students | ○ Menu: mySNU → 학사정보 (Academic Information) → 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) → 수업 (Classes) → 성적평가방법변경신청 (Grading Option Change Request) | How to apply
blocks.ko: 학생이 기간 내 신청 (담당 교원 승인 불요) 학생 ○ 메뉴: mySNU → 학사정보 → 수업/성적 → 수업 → 성적평가방법변경신청 신청 방법

blocks.en: ○ Student request: 등급제 (letter grades, A~F) → 급락제 (pass/fail, S/U)
blocks.ko: ○ 학생 신청: 등급제(A~F) → 급락제(S/U)

blocks.en: ※ Some major courses whose grading method is pass/fail (S/U) can also be changed to letter grades (A~F).
blocks.ko: ※ 성적평가방법이 급락제(S/U)인 일부 전공 교과목도 등급제(A~F)로 변경 가능

blocks.en: ○ If a student does not apply, the course's original grading method applies.
blocks.ko: ○ 학생이 신청하지 않을 경우, 교과목의 성적평가방법이 그대로 적용됨

blocks.en: Credits that can be requested: up to 9 credits in total during enrolment
blocks.ko: 신청 학점 재학 중 최대 9학점

blocks.en: Change of course classification | For a course in which an SNU student selected the grading option (A~F → S/U) and received an 'S' grade, the course classification cannot be changed (일선 (general elective) → 전선 (major elective)/전필 (major required)).
blocks.ko: 교과구분 본교생이 성적평가방법 선택(A~F→S/U)하여 ‘S’ 성적을 받은 교과목은 변경 교과구분 변경(일선→전선/전필) 불가

blocks.en: A retaken course follows the grading option chosen when the course was first taken. | Retaking | However, if a student received a U (fail) grade under pass/fail (S/U) when first taking the course, and then retakes it as a course of their own major after being selected for a multiple major, transferring to another major, etc., the course is completed with letter grades (A~F).
blocks.ko: 처음 수강할 때 선택한 성적평가방법으로 재수강 재수강 단, 처음 수강할 때 급락제(S/U)로 U(낙제) 성적을 받고 다전공 선발, 전과 등으로 본인 전공 교과목으로 재수강하는 경우는 등급제(A~F)로 이수

blocks.en: ※ This is unrelated to the grading option selection for liberal arts courses (physical education and special liberal arts courses), which is operated separately.
blocks.ko: ※ 교양 교과목 성적평가방법 선택(체육 및 특수 교양 교과목)과는 무관하며 별도로 운영

blocks.en: 3. Operation of the Grading Option Selection System for Major Courses of Other Departments
